about_the_game:
Oops, there's a wolf on the screen! 🐾🐾🐾

Desktop pet written by Zhou Zhou

Gameplay

Pets support basic functions such as clicking, dragging, following, stroking, and right-click menu.

Each pet supports personalization, with exclusive values and special gameplay!

Click to let the pet follow your mouse

Drag and drop to move pets freely

Touching pets and making cute movements can increase experience!

Pets can also help you take screenshots, read and copy text.

Pets are easy to use and have good compatibility

The game design is modularized, and each table pet is dynamically loaded, which can be imported and deleted at any time.

The game is implemented in Java and relies on the cross platform features of the Java Virtual Machine, which should be able to run on any modern computer.

Support expansion

If you have animation frame materials, you can create your own exclusive pet.

The author has written an automated production script for players. Please refer to the tutorial provided in the game to complete the production.

Players with a foundation in Java programming can read the documentation to create table pets that better suit their interests!
